message: Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && grep -n "SIZEOF_ARRAY" src/md4c.c | head -5` executed with exit code 0.

message.content:
The `md_ascii_case_eq` reads `n` characters from both `s1` and `s2`. `s2 = MD_ADMONITION_TAGS[i]` is a global string. Reading `n = md_strlen(MD_ADMONITION_TAGS[i])` characters from it is fine.

But `s1 = STR(line->beg+2)` reads from the input buffer. If the line is shorter than `n`, this reads past the end of the input buffer. This is a heap-buffer-overflow.

Hmm, but the crash is a global-buffer-overflow. Let me think about this differently.

Actually, wait. Let me reconsider. Maybe the global-buffer-overflow is caused by the `md_ascii_case_eq` reading from `MD_ADMONITION_TAGS[i]` when `i` is out of bounds. But `i` is bounded by `SIZEOF_ARRAY(MD_ADMONITION_TAGS)`.
